selector.why: The presence of intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo and the highlighting of fungal forms by special stains, along with the clinical presentation of a nonhealing ulcer, are most specifically accounted for by Primary oral histoplasmosis.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo and the highlighting of fungal forms by special stains, along with the clinical presentation of a nonhealing ulcer, are most specifically accounted for by Primary oral histoplasmosis.

support_spans: Many histiocytes and giant cells contained intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo
Special stains (Grocott-Gomori methenamine-silver nitrate and periodic acid–Schiff) highlighted fungal forms
contradict_spans: Fungal culture on Sabouraud dextrose agar was negative
supporting_evidence: Many histiocytes and giant cells contained intracellular yeasts with a surrounding halo
Special stains (Grocott-Gomori methenamine-silver nitrate and periodic acid–Schiff) highlighted fungal forms
contradicting_evidence: Fungal culture on Sabouraud dextrose agar was negative

support_spans: Single well-defined ulcer measuring 2 × 2 cm on the right lateral aspect of tongue with a clean base and irregular and elevated heaped-up margins
contradict_spans: No underlying induration, friability, or bleeding on manipulation
No history of trauma or tongue bite preceding the lesion
Patient denied consuming tobacco or alcohol regularly
